suppress.notes: httpcore 4.x is not affected by CVE-2026-54399 / CVE-2026-54428 (Apache advisory targets org.apache.httpcomponents.core5:httpcore5 only). No httpcore 4.x release exists beyond 4.4.16.
httpcore-nio 4.x shares the same false-positive CPE mapping as httpcore 4.x for CVE-2026-54399 / CVE-2026-54428.
CVE-2026-0994 affects Python protobuf JSON parsing only, not protobuf-java.
